day_local: Jimcaha Toddobaadka Labaad iyo Tobnaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wadaagga Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan dhammaantiin.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
Masiixow, naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuusta ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arkeysaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay diyaarad yar oo uu Ben ku ciyaari jiray, ama buug uu dhigay miiska, ama xataa xusuusta qosolkiisa markuu ka hadlayo 'con chim airlines'. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'tiriyaasha timaha madaxa'. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax aad u qurux badan: 'Xataa timaha madaxiinna oo dhan waa la tiriyey.' Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Ilaah, oo ah kan abuuray koonka, wuxuu yaqaan xataa tafaasiisha ugu yar ee qof kasta oo inaga mid ah. Wuxuu yaqaan Ben, wuxuu yaqaan Ryan, wuxuu yaqaan Alan iyo Thao. Waxba kama qarsoona Rabbiga. Tani ma aha oo kaliya xaqiiqo xisaabeed; waa ballanqaad jacayl. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu barto tafaasiisha—sida uu u darsayay AWS environments, sida uu u qorayay koodhka GitHub, ama sida uu ugu raaxaysan jiray daawashada diyaaradaha. Wuxuu ahaa wiil caqli badan oo fahmay in dunidu ay ka kooban tahay qaybo yaryar oo isku xiran. Hadda, isaga oo jooga gacmaha Ilaah, wuxuu si buuxda u fahmay in naftiisu ay ahayd mid qaaliga ah, oo aan marna laga tagin, oo si gaar ah loogu tiriyey jacaylka Aabbaha.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay ahaayeen kuwo adag. Waxaa jira waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in xanuunka uu ka weyn yahay iftiinka. Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo badan oo aan jawaab lahayn. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuxuu arkaa oohintiinna, wuxuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuxuu arkaa jacaylka aad weli u hayso Ben. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Do not be afraid. You are worth more than many sparrows.' (Ha baqina. Idinku waxaad ka qiimo badan tihiin shimbiraha badan.) Haa, qiimahaaga adiga, Alan, iyo adiga, Thao, iyo adiga, Ryan, waa mid aan la qiyaasi karin. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qiimeeyay dadka kale. Xusuusnow sida uu u rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'In Christ we were also chosen, destined in accord with the purpose of the One who accomplishes all things according to the intention of his will.' (Masiix dhexdiisa ayaa naloo doortay, annagoo loo qoondeeyey ujeeddada kan wax walba u fuliya si waafaqsan ujeeddada rabitaankiisa.) Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil loo doortay inuu iftiimiyo adduunkan. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in timaha madaxaaga ay Ilaah u yihiin kuwo la tiriyey. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramenta Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin si muuqata. Igu soo dhowow qalbigayga oo igu xidh naftaada weligaa. Ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna qaaliga ah ee Benjamin, iyo dhammaan kuwa naga horreeyey ee dhintay, ha ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan qoyska Vo, Ilaah ha u muujiyo naxariistiisa, ha siiyo xoog, oo ha ku dhex beerro rajo aan dhammaanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Masiix dhexdiisa ayaan innaguna ku doorannay, annagoo loo qoondeeyey ujeeddada kan wax walba u fuliya si waafaqsan ujeeddada rabitaankiisa, si aynu u jirno ammaanidda ammaantiisa, innaga oo ah kuwa ugu horreeyey ee Masiix rajeeyey. Isaga dhexdiisa ayaad idinkuna, oo maqlay ereyga runta ah, Injiilka badbaadadiinna, oo ku rumaystay isaga, lagu shaabadeeyey Ruuxa Quduuska ah ee la ballanqaaday, kaas oo ah qaybta hore ee dhaxalkeenna dhanka madaxfurashada sida hantida Ilaah, si loo ammaano ammaantiisa.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. Ku farxa, kuwa xaqa ah, Rabbiga; ammaanidda kuwa qumman ayaa habboon. Rabbiga ugu mahadnaqa kataaradda; kataaradda tobanka xadhig leh u gabya ammaantiisa. R. Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. Waayo, ereyga Rabbigu waa qumman yahay, shuqulladiisuna dhammaantood waa la aamini karaa. Wuxuu jecel yahay caddaaladda iyo xaqnimada; dhulkuna wuxuu ka buuxaa naxariista Rabbiga. R. Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. Barakaysan qaranka Ilaahiisu yahay Rabbiga, dadka uu u doortay dhaxalkiisa. Rabbigu wuxuu ka soo eegaa samada; wuxuu arkaa bini'aadamka oo dhan. R. Barakaysan dadka Rabbigu u doortay dhaxalkiisa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Waqtigaas: Dad aad u badan ayaa isugu soo ururay oo is-dul-marayay, Ciise wuxuu bilaabay inuu la hadlo, marka hore xertiisa, “Iska jira khamiirka—waa munaafaqnimada—Farisiyiinta. Ma jiro wax qarsoon oo aan la muujin doonin, ama sir aan la ogaan doonin. Sidaas darteed wax kasta oo aad ku tidhi gudcurka, waxaa lagu maqli doonaa iftiinka, oo waxa aad ku gunuusteen albaabbada xidhan ayaa lagu dhawaaqi doonaa saqafka sare. Waxaan idin leeyahay, saaxiibbadayow, ha ka baqina kuwa dila jidhka laakiin intaas ka dib aan wax kale samayn karin. Waxaan idin tusi doonaa cidda ay tahay inaad ka cabsataan. Ka cabsada kan, ka dib markuu dilo, awood u leh inuu ku tuuro Gehenna; haa, waxaan idin leeyahay, ka cabsada kan. Sow shan shimbirood looma iibiyo laba shilin oo yar? Haddana midkoodna kama maqna indhaha Ilaah. Xataa timaha madaxiinna oo dhan waa la tiriyey. Ha ka baqina. Idinku waxaad ka qiimo badan tihiin shimbiraha badan.”

day: Friday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
